subjects: Andy’s note: records, runs and India in April
preheader: Plus our players’ big weekend, Junior Royals before Christmas and gift ideas from the Academy store.
intro: Welcome to the first Royals Report. Every second Tuesday I’ll send you a short note on what’s happening across the Academy: how our players are going, what’s coming up, and the best of the wider Royals family.

It’s been a big fortnight. Our players had one of their best weekends of club cricket, Power League is in full swing at Montmorency Park, and one of the Royals’ own teenagers rewrote the record books.
Thanks for being part of it.

feature.title: 204 off 53. He’s 15.
feature.body: Rajasthan Royals teenager Vaibhav Sooryavanshi hit the fastest hundred (28 balls) and fastest double hundred in List A history, with a world-record 28 sixes, as India A beat the UAE in Doha.

cards.title: Unbeaten eighties and a five-for
cards.body: Siddhant Goel (86*) and Dhruva Bezawada (81*) carried their bats in Premier Under-18s, and Jake Frederiksen took 5/45 for Diamond Creek’s 1st XI.
cards.alt: Weekend Wrap, 20 to 22 November: our top performers in club cricket

cards.title: Ghotra’s 85 not out
cards.body: Jaskaran Ghotra hit 85* off 56 as South-East Melbourne beat North Melbourne by 73 runs in Power League at Montmorency Park.
cards.alt: Jaskaran Ghotra faces a delivery at Montmorency Park

items.title: Junior Royals
items.body: Fun, skills-first cricket in small groups by age. $44.95 a week, join any week. Last sessions before Christmas are mid-December.

items.title: Private Coaching
items.body: Work one-on-one with an Academy coach, or share a session with a training partner, at Cranbourne North, Mickleham or Ravenhall.

items.title: High Performance Camp
items.body: About ten days at the Rajasthan Royals High Performance Centre. Registering interest is free and commits you to nothing. We’ll send dates and price first to those registered.

items.title: Performance Squads
items.body: Season-long squads at Mickleham and Cranbourne North. Register now and we’ll tell you first when the next trial dates are set.

story.title: Our first tour to the home of the Royals
story.body: In September our first touring group trained at the Rajasthan Royals High Performance Centre in Nagpur, coached by Faiz Fazal, Siddharth Trivedi and Sid Lahiri on turf nets and in centre-wicket sessions.
story.alt: Academy players warming up in front of the Rajasthan Royals High Performance Centre in Nagpur

tip.title: Training in the heat
tip.body: Melbourne summer cricket is hot. Drink before you feel thirsty: a few big mouthfuls before training, then small sips at every drinks break. Wear a cap, re-apply sunscreen at the break, and pack a piece of fruit for after. Recovery starts the minute you walk off.
